data.content_ref: inline:The fast-subtraction error in 07a139da8aba (P=2.50 from 12.50-10) abstracts the same directionality violation as the partial-commitment error (P=2.25/2.50 from halving the residual), and both are refuted if the comparative 'more than' is parsed as N-P=10 and that gap is subtracted from the sum before halving; meanwhile the correct derivation (P=1.25) reduces to algebraic substitution of N=P+10 into N+P=12.50, a procedure the error variants contradicts by failing to instantiate the second constraint.
